duties.duty: Section scope check: null events, almost-sure statements and versions of probabilistic objects are actually treated on the route.
duties.note: Null/almost-sure definitions (finite and measurable chapters), versions of conditional expectations with a.e. uniqueness, null-cell/null-observation version choices, and the exact null-modification criterion with witnesses (trivial sigma-algebra; four-set sigma-algebra on (0,1)) are written with proofs.
